title: optcg.ch room links
description: Structure of data/links/<room-id>.yaml (see docs/plan.md section 5). The <room-id> comes from the file name and must exist in data/rooms.yaml (checked by the PHP validator, not by this schema).

id.description: Short, unique identifier (lower-case, hyphen-separated), for example 'bandai-tcg-plus'. Must be unique across all data/links/*.yaml files.

title.description: Short title, fits in 1-2 lines under the tile.

url.description: Target URL. Must use https:// and must not carry tracking parameters (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, ...).

language.description: Two-letter language code of the target website, for example 'en' or 'de'.

icon.description: Optional file name in public/link-icons/. Defaults to <id>.png when omitted. Must be square, PNG/SVG/WebP, within the maximum file size.

icon_source.description: 'fetched' = added by bin/fetch-icons.php, 'manual' = added by pull request and protected from being overwritten by the script.

featured.description: Optional. true = counts towards the folder preview (first 4 links, or the featured ones).
